resources.address: Online service covering supported areas in France
resources.summary: A multilingual solidarity map for nearby meals, drinking water, shelters, day centres, showers, laundry, clothing, health care, and administrative support.
resources.availabilityNote: Coverage and schedules are updated by area. Open each listing for its current hours and contact instructions.

resources.name: Eau de Paris Fountains Map
resources.costNote: Free to use and fill bottles
resources.summary: Eau de Paris provides an interactive map of over 1,200 public drinking fountains and 1,500 partner establishments across Paris. The service allows anyone to find free, safe drinking water and refill their bottles to stay hydrated and reduce single-use plastic.
services: Free water bottle refills at partner establishments
resources.availabilityNote: Available to everyone in the city, including public fountains and partner establishments.
resources.sourceKind: Official service locator or guidance page
resources.sourceDetail: The official Eau de Paris website provides an interactive map of public fountains and partner establishments where people can get free drinking water.
resources.verifiedQuote: "free, safe, and high-quality water" and "fill your bottle for free"
resources.coverageNote: Coverage area: Citywide map covering Paris. The map marker is geographic context, not a single service address.
